conventions.geometry: (Re w, Im w, asinh(Re(exp(-0.55i) q))); q=y for pure x maps, otherwise x. Finite endpoints are approached; the ray is truncated for display. Integrals include the exact endpoints and the entire infinite ray.

collection.normalization: normalized_regulator = w*(2*regulator + log|c|*period)/N; determinant_period = w*period; weight^N = c*Norm(phi); weight=(x-x(P)) at infinity, (x-x(P))/(x-x(Q)) at a finite pole
